notes.title: Enhancements arriving
notes.content:
News


Translated to German
Translated to Simplified Chinese


Visual Updates


Animation when use levers
Animation when place, move, mirror and rotate items
Visual Effect when you get a health recover item
Now the beetles will turn around in slopes, rocks and doors
The color of the wires was changed to "Green" in the biome "Temple" to be easier to see
Reset the "doublejump" When you jump in the bounces


Bugfixes


Fixed problems in tutorial texts
Fixed a problem with the saves when you use all the save slots
Fixed laser beams, now it won't cross doors
Fixed a bug where the game used to freeze when you get a item while in the air
Fixed some "flying items" in scenery
